dialogue.content: 本日相談者役をさせて頂きます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I'll be playing the role of the client today. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいいたします。少し早いですが、始めさせていただいていいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to meet you too. It's a little early, but would it be alright if we start?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。すみませんが、11時からでお願いしたいです。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm sorry, but could we please start at 11:00?

dialogue.content: かしこまりました。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Of course. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （始めさせていただきますね）
dialogue.English: (I'll get us started, then.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。初めにあなたの年齢、性別、相談内容を教えて頂いてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: あと、ここではなんとお呼びしたら良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Also, what would you like me to call you here?

dialogue.content: 16歳　男性好きな人が忘れられない
dialogue.English: 16 years old, male. I can't forget someone I like.

dialogue.content: 名前は特にいいです
dialogue.English: You don't need to use a name.

dialogue.content: はい、わかりました。好きな人がわすれられないんですね。。。お付き合いされていた方とかですか？
dialogue.English: Okay, I understand. You can't forget someone you like... Were you in a relationship with them?

dialogue.content: 好きな人。
dialogue.English: Someone I like.

dialogue.content: 付き合っていない
dialogue.English: We weren't dating.

dialogue.content: そうですか、好きな人なんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so it's someone you have feelings for.

dialogue.content: 胸が苦しい気持がされると思います。。。
dialogue.English: I imagine that must feel very painful...

dialogue.content: まあ、はい
dialogue.English: Well, yes.

dialogue.content: どんな時に、忘れられないとお感じになるのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: When do you find yourself feeling like you can't forget them?

dialogue.content: いつもです。思い出す事ばかり
dialogue.English: Always. I'm always thinking about them.

dialogue.content: いつもなのですね。。。
dialogue.English: So it's all the time...

dialogue.content: その人は学校の人？毎日見かけるような感じかな？
dialogue.English: Is this person from school? Do you see them every day?

dialogue.content: 中学で一緒でした
dialogue.English: We were in middle school together.

dialogue.content: 今は高校一年生？
dialogue.English: Are you a first-year high school student now?

dialogue.content: 今は別の高校です
dialogue.English: We go to different high schools now.

dialogue.content: 高2です
dialogue.English: I'm a second-year.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それで離れているけど思い出してしまわれるのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're apart now, but you still find yourself thinking about them.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 毎日思い出さずにいられないほど、素敵な人なのだろうなと伝わってきます。。。
dialogue.English: It sounds like they must be a wonderful person, if you can't help but think about them every day...

dialogue.content: まあ、はい
dialogue.English: Well, yes.

dialogue.content: どのように知り合ったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How did you two meet?

dialogue.content: 同じクラスとか？
dialogue.English: Were you in the same class or something?

dialogue.content: 中学の時に、
dialogue.English: In middle school,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 文化祭の実行委員会で、
dialogue.English: on the committee for the cultural festival,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 一緒に活動しました。
dialogue.English: we worked together.

dialogue.content: その時どんなところが良いなと思ったの？
dialogue.English: What was it about them that you liked at that time?

dialogue.content: クラスは1年の時に一緒で、でも話したことはなかった
dialogue.English: We were in the same class in our first year, but we had never talked.

dialogue.content: 優しいところ
dialogue.English: Their kindness.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 優しい人なんですね、素敵だね
dialogue.English: So they're a kind person. That's wonderful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は、学校が違うからなかなかお顔も見れない感じ？
dialogue.English: And now that you're at different schools, you don't get to see them much?

dialogue.content: あんまり会えないけど
dialogue.English: We don't see each other much, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 花火大会で見かけて
dialogue.English: I saw them at a fireworks festival,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 声をかけられなくて
dialogue.English: and I couldn't bring myself to talk to them.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 彼氏と一緒だったから
dialogue.English: because she was with her boyfriend.

dialogue.content: えー、それはショックを受けた出来事だったかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Oh, that must have been a very upsetting moment for you.

dialogue.content: まあ、はい
dialogue.English: Well, yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、当然の気持ちだと思います。
dialogue.English: Of course. I think that's a very natural reaction.

dialogue.content: それからずっと考えてます
dialogue.English: I've been thinking about it ever since.

dialogue.content: ずっと考えるようになっておられるのですね。。。
dialogue.English: So you've found yourself thinking about it constantly since then...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのことで眠れないとか
dialogue.English: Is it causing you to lose sleep or anything like that?

dialogue.content: 体調は大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: How is your physical health?

dialogue.content: 頭が痛いです
dialogue.English: I have headaches.

dialogue.content: いつも
dialogue.English: All the time.

dialogue.content: それは、睡眠不足気味なのかしら。
dialogue.English: I wonder if you might be a bit sleep-deprived.

dialogue.content: スマホとか長時間見ちゃうことも頭が痛くなるって言われていますね
dialogue.English: They do say that looking at a smartphone for too long can also cause headaches.

dialogue.content: そこまではないです
dialogue.English: It's not that bad.

dialogue.content: それなら少し安心しました。
dialogue.English: I'm a little relieved to hear that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは彼女に対してこれからどうしていきたいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to do about her going forward?

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そっかー
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ここまでお話お聞きして、それほど忘れられない人ならば、相談者さんの気持ちを伝えることを考えてみても良いかなって感じています。
dialogue.English: Hearing what you've shared so far, since she's someone you can't forget, I feel it might be worth considering telling her how you feel.

dialogue.content: 彼氏がいるのにですか
dialogue.English: Even though she has a boyfriend?

dialogue.content: その男の人、本当に彼氏かどうか一緒に居ただけってことも有るのかなって思いました。
dialogue.English: I was just wondering if he was really her boyfriend—it's possible they were just together at that moment.

dialogue.content: 聞いています。周りから。彼氏ができたみたいだと。
dialogue.English: I've heard from people around me that she has a boyfriend.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、聞いていらしたんですね。。。
dialogue.English: I see, so you had already heard that...

dialogue.content: 気持ちを伝えることは抵抗がある？
dialogue.English: Do you feel resistant to the idea of telling her how you feel?

dialogue.content: だから彼氏がいるから
dialogue.English: Because she has a boyfriend.

dialogue.content: 普通考えてムリでしょう
dialogue.English: Realistically, that's impossible, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そう思われるのですね。。。
dialogue.English: That's how you see it...

dialogue.content: 彼女を想う気持ちはとても素敵な事だと思います。
dialogue.English: I think your feelings for her are a wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: 彼女じゃないです
dialogue.English: She's not my girlfriend.

dialogue.content: すいません、その同級生という意味です。誤解を生むような言葉でしたね。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I meant your former classmate. That was a poor choice of words that could cause misunderstanding.

dialogue.content: 別にいいです
dialogue.English: It's fine.

dialogue.content: 例えば、気持ちを少し整理するためにノートなどに書いてみるのはいかがでしょう。
dialogue.English: For example, how about trying to write your feelings down in a notebook to help organize them?

dialogue.content: ここって自分の話をしてはいけないんですか。
dialogue.English: Am I not supposed to talk about myself here?

dialogue.content: 相談の案内に、あなたの話を聞かせてください、どんな話でも大丈夫ですと書いてあったから
dialogue.English: The counseling information said, “Please tell us your story—any kind of story is fine,”

dialogue.content: それできたんです
dialogue.English: so that's why I came.

dialogue.content: いえ、そんなことはありません。質問がおおかったですね、すいません。
dialogue.English: No, that's not the case at all. I was asking a lot of questions, wasn't I? I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 同級生の方を忘れられない気持ち、おはなししていただいたのに、嫌な気分がされましたね、すいません
dialogue.English: You shared your feelings about not being able to forget your classmate, and I made you feel uncomfortable. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 少しお待ちしていますね。
dialogue.English: I'll wait for a moment.

dialogue.content: どうしていいかわからない。まだ好きなんだと思うし、忘れられないです。
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do. I think I still like her, and I can't forget her.

dialogue.content: その方を好きな気持ち、とても伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: Your feelings for her come through very clearly.

dialogue.content: 好きでい続けることは素敵だと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I think it's a wonderful thing to continue liking someone.

dialogue.content: 新学期も始まって
dialogue.English: The new school term has started,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 勉強もしたいのに
dialogue.English: and I want to study, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: このままではいけないですよね
dialogue.English: I can't go on like this, can I?

dialogue.content: このままではいけないような気持がしてしまうのですね。。。
dialogue.English: So you're feeling like you can't go on like this...

dialogue.content: 忘れられない気持ちを抱えながらも、前に進もうとしている相談者さんは、とっても真面目に自分を大切にできる人だと感じています。
dialogue.English: Even while holding onto these feelings you can't forget, the fact that you're trying to move forward makes me feel you're a very earnest person who can take good care of yourself.

dialogue.content: でも何にも出来てないから
dialogue.English: But I haven't been able to do anything.

dialogue.content: 今、出来るようになりたいという気持ちがあることが大切な第一歩に見えています。
dialogue.English: The fact that you have the desire to be able to do something now seems like a very important first step.

dialogue.content: 疲れたので終わりにしていいですか
dialogue.English: I'm tired. Is it okay if we end here?

dialogue.content: かしこまりました。また、いつでもお話に来てくださいありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Of course. Please feel free to come and talk anytime. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: （大変ありがとうございました、勉強させていただきました。とっても難しくて、うまく出来なくて申し訳ありませんでした）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much, this was a great learning experience. It was very difficult, and I apologize that I couldn't do it well.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。後から振り返り送りますね。お疲れ様でした。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. I'll send my reflections later. Thank you for your work.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
